draft_queue.snippet: Praised putting networking, follow-ups and content planning in one workspace.
draft_queue.draft_text: Minami, thank you for noticing that part! Keeping networking, follow-ups and content planning in one place was the whole point. I didn't want the follow-through to depend on my memory after the event. What's the piece you usually lose track of after you meet people?

draft_queue.author: Gladys Mae
draft_queue.conversation: The Visibility Edit: I built a whole networking dashboard for today's event (Anisia's post)
draft_queue.snippet: Emphasized the follow-up tracker and nurturing relationships over time.
draft_queue.draft_text: Yes, Gladys! Collecting contacts is the easy part. Nurturing the relationship after the event is where the value actually is, so the follow-up tracker got its own spot instead of living in my head. How do you keep up with people after you first connect?
